title: Senior Product Designer
jobDescription:
To succeed in this role you must have experience in and be able to:

  • Design and develop integration solutions for applications, ensuring they align with business and technical requirements.

  • Conduct in-depth analysis to understand the underlying problems associated with integration challenges and propose effective solutions.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and stakeholders, to drive innovative integration designs.

  • Ensure the designed integration solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable.

  • Optimize and refine existing integrations for improved performance and efficiency.

  • Stay updated with industry best practices, tools, and technologies to continually improve integration methodologies.

Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited university in a Computer Science, Interaction Design, and/or Visual Communication Design discipline 

  • 5+ years of experience in digital product development such as mobile/desktop apps, web, and/or digital ecosystems 

  • Experience on cross-functional design and development teams creating web-based products

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating discovery, interaction, and visual design skills for mobile and desktop/web applications

  • Experience leading projects end-to-end, using design rationale based on metrics, customer feedback, and usability findings, and presenting to leadership and executives

  • Fluency in Chinese (Mandarin) and English, proficiency in both English speaking and writing

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience designing SaaS products for a B2B company

  • Experience in the cloud-based communications and collaborations industry

  • Experience working on global and remote teams

  • Experience in Figma

  • Ability to plan/facilitate workshops and group design activities
